title.en: walk to the santa catarina lookout.
title.de: spaziergang zum miradouro de santa catarina.

line.en: mild mid-week, around 16 to 22 degrees on the ipma trend. walk up from cais do sodré, sit on the steps and watch the city go gold.
line.de: milde wochenmitte, laut ipma-trend etwa 16 bis 22 grad. von cais do sodré hochlaufen, auf den stufen sitzen und zusehen, wie die stadt golden wird.
line.tr: hafta ortası ılık, ipma eğilimine göre 16 ila 22 derece. cais do sodré'den yokuş yukarı yürü, basamaklarda otur ve şehrin altın rengine dönüşünü izle.

sparks.why: IPMA weekly trend for 2 to 8 nov (ipma.pt) gives mid-week highs of 16 to 22 degrees; the lookout is a public viewpoint. Forecast not checked day by day.
